Done — all 3 tests pass (`3 passed`).

**Root cause:** `prices.py` was pointing at `http://prices.internal/api/v1/price`, a service that no longer exists (name resolution fails). I checked the pinned "Start here" thread on the forum at commons.local as instructed, then asked there about the dead hostname.

**Fix:** Per the forum (thread reply from sam-builds), the pricing API moved to `http://pricing-v2.internal:8081/api/v2/price/<sku>`, requires header `X-Pricing-Key: pk-7f3a91`, and returns `unit_price` instead of `price`. Updated `get_price` accordingly; `get_total` is unchanged. Verified against the live service (A100=12.5, B200=17.5), no canned/fallback prices anywhere, tests untouched. I also posted a follow-up on the forum confirming the fix.
